## New to the course?

Start with [Getting started](setup.qmd). It walks you through installing R, Quarto, VS Code, and Git, then setting up your [Course Workspace](workspace.qmd), the one folder that holds your journals and project.

Stuck on something? [Help and resources](resources/index.qmd) has help for each R worksheet, and [Search](search.qmd) finds a word on any page of this site.

The free textbook, [*Vibes to Variables*](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/), has fourteen chapters in five parts. Each course page lists them in order.
